method: Native Ollama requests were forwarded through a loopback-only diagnostic proxy. Only public message content/tool calls were captured; reasoning was not stored.
The final evaluation used the same existing binary, fixtures and prompts. No agent/provider prompts, citation checks, permissions, criterion kinds or criterion count changed.
A temporary Go test overlay reevaluated the identical baseline public answers, then swapped their output labels and appended contradictory versions. The overlay is not shipped.
The baseline English answer still fails its independent missing-function check when reevaluated with the new patterns. The final fresh English answer satisfied all original checks.
limits: These are deterministic checks of explicitly associated fixture values, not a semantic judge for arbitrary prose.
Associations remain bounded to supported clauses/items, indented continuation or an explicit heading and its immediate paragraph.
One passing four-case local run is not a universal model-quality rate.
No new PTY run was needed: application/UI/permission/citation production code is byte-for-byte unchanged from the prior validated commit.
